tickets.subject: API errors right after new connector went live
tickets.body: Since the new ERP connector went live last week, our existing API integration (unrelated to that connector directly, as far as I can tell) has started throwing intermittent 500 errors on pulls that were working fine before. Not sure if the two are connected on your end, but the timing is suspicious. We're mid-close right now so a quick look would help. We had a brief look at Dashlume last year during a vendor refresh and nothing came of it then, but this kind of knock-on effect is the sort of thing that would bring it back into the conversation. Sigrid

tickets.subject: Third issue this month — alert firing on stale connector data
tickets.body: Following the connector setup and the API errors Sigrid raised, we've now had an alert fire based on what turned out to be stale data from the new connector rather than a genuine threshold breach, which caused a bit of unnecessary alarm internally. Three issues in the same fortnight, all touching the same new connector, isn't a great start to using it. We'll hold off adding any further data sources through it for now and stick to manual checks until we're more confident. Not urgent, but wanted the pattern on record. Britta
